entities.summary: Hempstead Washburne was an American attorney and Republican politician from Illinois. He served as the 32nd mayor of Chicago, from 1891 to 1893. He was a member of the Washburn family of Maine, and was the son of United States Secretary of State Elihu B. Washburne.
